text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 5: CAMS clearness index against ERA5 cloud water, by low-cloud cover'
text.tspan: Figure 5: CAMS clearness index against ERA5 cloud water, by low-cloud

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS: satellite irradiance service. Each dot: the mean over one fifteenth of the hours in its low-cloud group, ranked by cloud water. Clearness index: irradiance divided by the irradiance at the top of the atmosphere.'
text.tspan: Six NGED solar farms, daylight hours, September 2019 to June 2026. ERA5: ECMWF's reanalysis of past weather. CAMS:
Each dot: the mean over one fifteenth of the hours in its low-cloud group, ranked by cloud water.
Clearness index: irradiance divided by the irradiance at the top of the atmosphere.
